evidence_quotes.agenda: "Do you have any special instructions, concerns or stresser about moving in general that you want me to take note of at this time?" — asked after unit/oversized-item/fragile/box/floor/parking probing was already done
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: "Not that, I can think of" — no concern raised, no-concern-raised exception applied
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "it's a little bit difficult for us to assess how long it's gonna take unless we have an inventory list... I'll just put you within that range" (window) + "we only charge in fifteen minute intervals" (beats-it-pay-less) — two of five lines present

top_strength: Handled an unusual storage-to-storage, partial-unit move (two different units, not fully emptying either) with real clarity — clean weight-limit and truck-capacity framing despite the lack of a normal room-by-room inventory.
coaching_note: No self-prep tip or rate-commitment/fairness-check lines made it into Save Your Ass — worth adding the offer to trade an inventory list for a tighter estimate range as the self-prep hook on ambiguous jobs like this one.
